content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto is a straightforward process that involves creating a digital product, setting a price, and receiving payment in cryptocurrency. This approach allows creators to maintain ownership of their products and customer data, ensuring they are not beholden to third-party platforms. By using crypto payments, creators can also tap into a global market, reaching customers in regions where traditional payment methods are limited or unavailable. This infrastructure is built on the principles of sovereignty and decentralization, giving creators the freedom to operate their businesses as they see fit.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling Notion templates for crypto relies on a combination of tools and services. Creators use platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order information, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver the digital products. NOWPayments facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, making it easy for creators to receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies. This infrastructure is designed to be scalable, secure, and easy to use, even for those without extensive technical expertise.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who cannot use Stripe or PayPal, such as those in Kenya. These creators need a reliable and secure way to sell their digital products, like Notion templates, and reach a global audience. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, they can maintain control over their sales and customer data, while also tapping into the benefits of crypto payments. This approach is ideal for creators who value independence and want to build a sustainable online business that is not reliant on third-party platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives creators control over their sales and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Each of these components works together seamlessly to create a streamlined and efficient sales process. For example, when a customer purchases a Notion template, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, and the digital product is delivered automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This integration is made possible through the use of APIs and webhooks, which enable the different components to communicate with each other.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, creators can start by setting up their hosting and backend logic. They can then integrate their order storage and file delivery systems, and finally, add payment processing through NOWPayments. By following these steps, creators can quickly and easily establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows them to sell Notion templates for crypto. This infrastructure can be customized to meet the needs of individual creators, and can be scaled up or down as needed to accommodate growing sales and customer bases.
